Our story

Aetheria began with a question: what if skincare felt like looking up at the night sky? We pair gemstone minerals with botanicals, then pour every formula into glass you will want to keep.

Mineral-richMalachite, pearl and quartz
BotanicalLavender, reishi and chamomile
Made to keepGlass and metal packaging
